column1: # The message form, rules 1 and 3 (F-203; docs/SPEC-TABLES.md 3.3;
# review-owed/cross-leg/message-form). The reader is reader.schema; each row
# is one message batch of Msg after writer.schema's announcement, which ranges
# a and b over [250, 255], c over [2^64 - 6, 2^64 - 1] and d over
# [2^63 - 6, 2^63 - 1], each offset in three bits, so an offset can spell a
# value past the announced kind; and adds a union field u the reader does not
# Rule 1: an integer read by name is base plus offset taken exactly and held
# to the announced kind, never wrapped: 257 announced as a uint8 is refused in
# a uint8 and in the uint16 it widens into; a uint64 or int64 base near its
# edge plus an offset past it is refused, not landed wrapped round.
# Rule 3: a union field the reader skips, written with arm reference 0, is
# refused; a lawful arm there is skipped and counted unknown.
# batch: the fields in body order, each name:offset, or u:arm:value for the
#        union field at that arm, or u:0 for arm reference 0
